nodes.description: Public string state variable holding the token name, set to 'Cyber Punk Inu' in the constructor.
Public string state variable holding the token symbol, set to 'CPI' in the constructor.
Public uint8 state variable holding the token decimals, set to 9 in the constructor.
Public uint256 state variable holding the total token supply, initialized to 10000 * 10**18 in the constructor.
Private mapping(address => uint) tracking the token balance of every account; mutated by constructor, transfer and transferFrom.
Private nested mapping(address => mapping(address => uint)) storing ERC20 allowances; mutated by approve and transferFrom.
CyberPunkInu constructor: sets name, symbol, decimals and _totalSupply and credits the whole supply to msg.sender.
Public view returning _totalSupply minus balances[address(0)], performing an unchecked subtraction.
Public view returning the balance of the given tokenOwner from the balances mapping.
Public view returning the remaining allowance of spender for tokenOwner from the allowed mapping.
Public function setting allowed[msg.sender][spender] to tokens and emitting Approval.
Public function moving tokens from msg.sender to 'to' using safeSub and safeAdd on the balances mapping.
Public function moving tokens from 'from' to 'to' using safeSub/safeAdd and decrementing allowed[from][msg.sender].
SafeMath helper that computes c = a + b and requires c >= a to guard against overflow.
SafeMath helper that requires b <= a then computes c = a - b to guard against underflow.
SafeMath helper that computes c = a * b and requires a == 0 || c / a == b.
SafeMath helper that requires b > 0 then computes c = a / b.
The caller address supplied by the transaction; used as mapping key and recipient/owner of balances and allowances.
Balance arithmetic inside transfer (safeSub debit then safeAdd credit of the balances mapping).
Balance and allowance arithmetic inside transferFrom (safeSub on balances[from] and allowed[from][msg.sender], safeAdd on balances[to]).
Unchecked subtraction '_totalSupply - balances[address(0)]' inside totalSupply, which can underflow if the zero address ever holds a balance.
Addition 'a + b' guarded by require(c >= a) inside safeAdd.
Subtraction 'a - b' guarded by require(b <= a) inside safeSub.
Multiplication 'a * b' guarded by require(a == 0 || c / a == b) inside safeMul.
Division 'a / b' guarded by require(b > 0) inside safeDiv.
Parameter 'to' (address) of transfer, the recipient credited with tokens.
Parameter 'tokens' (uint) of transfer, the amount moved from msg.sender to 'to'.
Parameter 'from' (address) of transferFrom, the account whose tokens are debited.
Parameter 'to' (address) of transferFrom, the account credited with tokens.
Parameter 'tokens' (uint) of transferFrom, the amount moved between 'from' and 'to'.
Parameter 'spender' (address) of approve, the account granted an allowance by msg.sender.
Parameter 'tokens' (uint) of approve, the allowance amount written into allowed[msg.sender][spender].
Parameter 'tokenOwner' (address) of balanceOf, the account whose balance is looked up.
Parameter 'spender' (address) of allowance, the account whose remaining allowance is looked up.
Return value 'c' of safeAdd holding the result of a + b.
Return value 'c' of safeSub holding the result of a - b.

edges.reason: The constructor writes the initial _totalSupply value (10000 * 10**18).
The constructor assigns the whole supply to balances[msg.sender].
msg.sender is used by the constructor as the initial token holder.
approve uses msg.sender as the allowance owner key in allowed[msg.sender][spender].
transfer uses msg.sender as the account whose balance is debited and as the Transfer emitter.
transferFrom uses msg.sender as the spender key when decrementing allowed[from][msg.sender].
approve writes the requested amount into the allowed mapping.
transfer reads and writes the balances mapping for msg.sender and 'to'.
transferFrom reads and writes the balances mapping for 'from' and 'to'.
transferFrom decrements the caller's allowance in the allowed mapping.
totalSupply reads the _totalSupply state variable.
totalSupply reads balances[address(0)] when computing the circulating supply.
balanceOf returns the value stored in the balances mapping.
allowance returns the value stored in the allowed mapping.
transfer calls safeSub to debit balances[msg.sender] with tokens.
transfer calls safeAdd to credit balances[to] with tokens.
transferFrom calls safeSub on balances[from] and on allowed[from][msg.sender].
transferFrom calls safeAdd on balances[to].
transfer's balance updates are the arithmetic operation node for this function.
transferFrom's balance/allowance updates are the arithmetic operation node for this function.
totalSupply performs the subtraction _totalSupply - balances[address(0)].
safeAdd performs the guarded addition a + b.
safeSub performs the guarded subtraction a - b.
safeMul performs the guarded multiplication a * b.
safeDiv performs the guarded division a / b.
The 'to' parameter of transfer determines the credited balance entry.
The 'tokens' parameter of transfer determines the debited/credited amount.
The 'from' parameter of transferFrom determines the debited balance entry.
The 'to' parameter of transferFrom determines the credited balance entry.
The 'tokens' parameter of transferFrom determines the moved amount.
The 'spender' parameter of approve keys the allowance entry.
The 'tokens' parameter of approve is stored as the allowance value.
The 'tokenOwner' parameter of balanceOf selects the balance to return.
The 'spender' parameter of allowance selects the allowance to return.
Local 'c' is the return variable assigned by safeAdd.
Local 'c' is the return variable assigned by safeSub.

normalization_plan.reason: The recipient parameter only exists to index balances in transfer and carries no independent semantics.
The amount parameter is only meaningful as the argument of the safeSub/safeAdd calls inside transfer.
The 'from' parameter is only used to index balances[from] and allowed[from][msg.sender] inside transferFrom.
The 'to' parameter is only used to index balances[to] inside transferFrom.
The amount parameter feeds the safeSub/safeAdd arithmetic of transferFrom and has no standalone meaning.
The spender parameter only serves as the second key of allowed[msg.sender][spender] in approve.
The tokens parameter is written directly into the allowed mapping by approve.
The tokenOwner parameter is only a lookup key for the balances mapping in balanceOf.
The spender parameter is only a lookup key for the allowed mapping in allowance.
The local return variable c is fully determined by the addition guarded inside safeAdd.
The local return variable c is fully determined by the subtraction guarded inside safeSub.
